post.description:
Pick a photo from Immich, render it (face-aware crop) and make it the current image.

People are plain names resolved per account; ``persons``, ``match_mode``, ``album_*``
and ``always_include`` fall back to the ``immich`` section of the configuration.
The photo is recorded in the history so it is not shown again within
``immich.anti_repeat_days``. When pushed to the frame, the request becomes the rule
replayed by ``POST /api/refresh`` and the scheduler, and the refresh timer restarts.
With ``ephemeral`` the request is not stored as that rule; ``hold_minutes`` keeps the
image up for at least that long. A direct push never changes the Smart Mix playlist.

post.description:
Show the full, uncropped cover with the title, artist and album underneath.

The cover is ``artwork_base64`` / ``artwork_url`` when usable; otherwise (with
``enrich_artwork``) a 1000x1000 cover is looked up on Deezer, then MusicBrainz / Cover
Art Archive; otherwise a typographic card is shown.

The cover is **ephemeral** by default. It expires when the track should be over
(``duration_seconds - position_seconds`` plus ``music.ttl_grace_seconds``, or
``ttl_seconds``, or ``music.default_ttl_minutes``) and on
``DELETE /api/queue/ephemeral``; the previous image then comes back. Sending the track
that is already displayed only moves its expiry (``deduplicated: true``), so Home
Assistant can call this on every attribute change.

post.description:
Find the title on TMDB and show its best poster, uncropped, over a blurred backdrop.

Posters are ranked for ``language`` (default ``tmdb.language``): exact language and
region first (``fr``/``FR``), then the same language, textless artwork, English, and
anything else. When TMDB has no match or fails, ``fallback_base64`` / ``fallback_url``
(e.g. the Home Assistant ``media_player`` picture) is used, then
``/data/assets/tmdb_fallback.png``, then a typographic title card.

By default the poster is **ephemeral**: after ``ttl_minutes`` (default
``tmdb.ephemeral_ttl_minutes``) or ``DELETE /api/queue/ephemeral`` the previous image comes
back, and a deep-sleeping frame that wakes up later never receives an expired poster.

Render an uploaded image for the frame and make it the current image.

In ``continuous`` mode the response includes the delivery outcome; in ``deepsleep``
mode the image is queued until the frame wakes up. A pushed upload restarts the
refresh timer but keeps the rule replayed by ``POST /api/refresh``.

delete.description:
Drop a queued movie poster or album cover and restore the previous image.

Call it when playback pauses or stops. The previous non-ephemeral image becomes the
current image again; it is re-sent only if the frame may not be showing it (a sleeping
frame that never received the cover is not woken up). Without a previous image, a
background refresh replays the active rule. Calling it when nothing is ephemeral is a
harmless no-op (``cancelled: false``).

post.description:
Show a new image chosen by the active rule and push it to the frame.

The active rule is the pinned ``scheduler.source_rule`` when set, otherwise the last
request made through ``POST /api/display/immich``. Unlike scheduled refreshes, a
manual refresh ignores quiet hours and a pending upload. It restarts the timer.
